findings: Ownership is closed: GB0001 owns G0001,G0002; GB0002 owns G0003,G0004; GB0003 owns G0005. Each G declares its owning batch and each batch has fewer than five G outputs.
Canonical coverage is assigned and evidenced by the five detailed bibles: GAME-001 through GAME-012 and GPI-001 through GPI-015 are represented; G dependencies reference earlier available G outputs.

The quiz-content-and-editorial-integrity module is not accepted: QB-A-01 through QB-A-48 are explicitly draft records with only pending review records. The catalogue defines required provenance locators and two distinct accepted reviews, but does not contain a completed provenance record, factual/rights decision, accessibility/copy decision, or second-review decision for any card revision.

Because GPI-002 through GPI-005 lack published cards with accepted provenance and two reviews, GAME-002 and the downstream GAME-004/GAME-006 publication-dependent selection evidence remain conditional and the manifest cannot be accepted.
